title: Ready, episode 3: what they will see
needs: Clip check: s09-slow offsets for the three moments

beats.quote: I want them to come to me first.

beats.line: A horrible message in the group chat.

beats.me: She showed me a horrible message from a group chat. What do I say?

digi: Right now: thank her for coming to you first. That is the win.
Next: ask what she thinks it means, before you decide anything.
This week: tell me how it goes, and I will check back.

beats.line: DiGi checks back on what it suggested.
She came to you, not around you.
